sys_atf_test.description: Tests that the auto-select-supplier before-insert business rule on proc_ord auto-populates the supplier field with the highest cumulative_score active and available supplier when the supplier field is left empty. Creates three suppliers with cumulative_scores of 60, 90, and 80, then inserts a procurement order without specifying a supplier. Validates that the supplier field was auto-populated by the business rule. Cleans up all records.
sys_atf_test.name: Auto-Select Best Supplier Test
